zh.headline: Microsoft Build 2026 发布七大重磅更新，含自研推理模型与 AI 助手
zh.observation: 今天最明确的信号是 **AI 基础设施从“建模型”向“管代理”的范式转移**。Microsoft Build 2026 的 Scout、Meta 的 WhatsApp AI 代理、Coralogix 的 2 亿美元融资，都在指向同一个方向：AI 代理正在从 demo 走向生产，而管理、监控、编排这些代理将成为下一个基础设施级机会。与此同时，token 成本管控成为企业级痛点——Uber 的预算超支和 headroom、rtk 等压缩工具的火爆，说明“AI 用得起”比“AI 有多强”更迫切。最后，Nvidia RTX Spark 将 AI 推理推向笔记本端，边缘 AI 的硬件瓶颈正在被打破，开发者应开始关注本地部署的可行性。

items.title: Anthropic 提交招股书，最快 Q4 上市
items.desc: Anthropic 正式提交 IPO 招股书，计划最快 2026 年第四季度上市，成为 AI 领域最受关注的 IPO 事件之一。
items.value: AI 独角兽资本化里程碑，影响行业估值与人才流动

items.title: Microsoft Build 2026 发布七大重磅更新，含自研推理模型与 AI 助手
items.desc: 微软在 Build 大会上发布旗舰推理模型 MAI-Thinking-1、AI 助手 Microsoft Scout（基于 OpenClaw），以及一系列 AI 代理工具，标志着微软正式从 OpenAI 依赖走向自研路线。
items.value: 微软与 OpenAI 关系松动，自研模型生态成型，开发者需关注新平台

items.title: Google 推出 Gemini Omni：15 分钟克隆你的 AI 分身
items.desc: Google 发布 Gemini Omni 功能，用户可通过扫描二维码在 15 分钟内创建自己的 AI 数字化身，包括面部克隆和语音合成。
items.value: AI 个人分身进入实用阶段，对内容创作和客服场景影响大

items.title: Google 发布 Dreambeans：将你的生活数据变成 AI 漫画故事
items.desc: Google 推出 Dreambeans 工具，从用户 Google 账户的个人数据中提取信息，生成 AI 插画风格的个性化“故事”。
items.value: 个人数据驱动的 AI 叙事新范式，隐私与创意边界再讨论

items.title: Meta 的 WhatsApp Business AI 代理全球上线，按 token 收费
items.desc: Meta 宣布其 WhatsApp Business AI 代理在全球范围内可用，企业将根据 token 使用量付费，标志着 AI 客服商业化进入新阶段。
items.value: AI 客服大规模商业化落地，中小企业接入门槛降低

items.title: 英国监管机构要求 Google 允许出版商退出 AI 搜索
items.desc: 英国竞争与市场管理局（CMA）裁定，Google 必须提供工具让网站出版商选择不被 AI 搜索功能（如 AI Overviews）抓取内容，该选项将在英国测试后全球推广。
items.value: AI 搜索版权博弈升级，内容生态规则重塑

items.title: Alphabet 创纪录的 850 亿美元融资，为 AI 业务注入强心剂
items.desc: Alphabet 完成史上最大规模的 850 亿美元股票发行，专门用于支持 Google 的 AI 业务，显示投资者对 AI 领域仍有巨大信心。
items.value: AI 军备竞赛资金弹药充足，行业竞争将更加激烈

items.title: Lovable 与 Google Cloud 续签多年合同，使用量提升 5 倍
items.desc: AI 应用构建平台 Lovable 与 Google Cloud 签署多年期扩展协议，在 Google Cloud 上的业务规模将扩大 5 倍，并扩大对 Anthropic Claude 的访问。
items.value: AI 应用平台基础设施需求爆发，云厂商受益明确

items.title: Coralogix 融资 2 亿美元，押注 AI 代理监控赛道
items.desc: 基础设施公司 Coralogix 完成 2 亿美元融资，专注于为 AI 代理提供行为监控、故障排查和运维数据平台。
items.value: AI 代理进入生产环境，运维监控成为新刚需

items.title: Nvidia RTX Spark 笔记本芯片发布，AI PC 或迎来转折点
items.desc: Nvidia 发布 RTX Spark 芯片，有望将“AI PC”从概念变为现实，在笔记本端提供强大的本地 AI 推理能力。
items.value: 边缘 AI 推理硬件突破，开发者可部署更复杂的本地模型

items.title: OpenAI 挖走哈佛最年轻正教授、中科大少年班校友
items.desc: OpenAI 持续增强研究实力，招募了 12 岁上大学的哈佛史上最年轻正教授，以及另一位知名学者苏炜杰。
items.value: 顶级 AI 人才争夺白热化，学术圈向产业流动加速

items.title: Uber 限制员工 AI 支出，预算 4 个月耗尽
items.desc: Uber 在鼓励员工尽可能使用 AI 后，因预算在 4 个月内超支，不得不设置 AI 使用上限。
items.value: 企业 AI 成本管控成为新课题，token 经济需要更精细化管理

items.title: 跨维智能登顶世界模型榜单 WorldArena
items.desc: 跨维智能（Cross-dimensional Intelligence）在 WorldArena 世界模型排行榜上取得第一，展示了在具身智能和世界理解方面的进展。
items.value: 世界模型竞争格局变化，新玩家挑战头部地位

items.title: WALL-WM：以事件为单位的 World Action Model 预训练新方法
items.desc: 提出 WALL-WM，将视频-动作学习从固定长度片段优化转向以语义连贯事件为基本单位的视觉-语言-动作预训练，解决了现有世界动作模型的粒度不匹配问题。
items.value: 为具身智能和机器人学习提供更自然的预训练范式

items.title: OmniOPD：无需教师 logits 的 On-Policy 蒸馏方法
items.desc: 提出 OmniOPD，通过推测验证机制实现无需访问教师模型 logits 的 on-policy 蒸馏，让闭源模型也能作为教师指导小模型训练。
items.value: 降低对 GPT-4 等闭源模型 logits 的依赖，知识蒸馏更灵活

items.title: KVarN：方差归一化的 KV-Cache 量化方法
items.desc: 提出 KVarN，通过归一化 KV-Cache 量化中的方差，有效缓解推理任务中长序列解码时的误差累积问题。
items.value: 提升长上下文推理效率，降低显存瓶颈

items.title: AURA：面向机器人策略的恒定显存动作门控记忆
items.desc: 提出 AURA-Mem，一种专为边缘端机器人设计的动作门控记忆架构，在恒定 VRAM 下支持长周期运行，解决了 KV-Cache 不适合机器人场景的问题。
items.value: 机器人端侧推理的内存瓶颈突破，推动具身智能落地

items.title: Small RL Controller, Large Language Model：RL 引导的自适应采样
items.desc: 将测试时扩展的自适应采样问题建模为马尔可夫决策过程，训练轻量级 RL 控制器动态决定何时停止采样，在提升推理性能的同时降低计算成本。
items.value: 更智能的测试时计算分配，降低推理成本

items.title: Ultralytics YOLO26：统一的实时端到端视觉模型
items.desc: 发布 YOLO26 系列，在 YOLO 家族基础上实现无需 NMS 的端到端检测、更轻量的检测头、更短的训练周期，并解决小目标正样本分配问题。
items.value: 计算机视觉领域最广泛使用的模型家族迎来重大更新

items.title: ByG：无配对数据的流匹配图像编辑框架
items.desc: 提出 Bootstrap Your Generator (ByG)，利用基础生成模型的先验知识，无需配对数据即可训练流匹配图像编辑模型，并扩展至视频编辑。
items.value: 大幅降低图像/视频编辑模型的训练数据门槛

items.title: PaddleOCR-VL-1.6：区域感知优化的文档解析模型
items.desc: 百度发布 PaddleOCR-VL-1.6，通过识别模型不稳定、数据覆盖稀疏的“欠优化区域”，进行针对性数据增强和渐进式后训练，在 0.9B 参数下显著提升文档解析能力。
items.value: 小模型文档解析能力提升，对 OCR 和文档处理有直接实用价值

items.title: codegraph：预索引代码知识图谱，减少 AI 编码代理的 token 消耗
items.desc: 为 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini 等 AI 编码代理提供预索引的代码知识图谱，可减少 token 消耗和工具调用次数，100% 本地运行。
items.value: AI 编码效率提升利器，大幅降低使用成本

items.title: oh-my-pi：终端 AI 编码代理
items.desc: 终端 AI 编码代理，支持哈希锚定编辑、优化的工具框架、LSP、Python、浏览器、子代理等特性。
items.value: 终端 AI 代理新选择，功能全面且可扩展

items.title: headroom：压缩工具输出和日志，减少 60-95% token 消耗
items.desc: 在工具输出、日志、文件和 RAG 片段到达 LLM 之前进行压缩，可减少 60-95% 的 token 消耗，同时保持答案质量。提供库、代理和 MCP 服务器三种使用方式。
items.value: 直接降低 AI 应用 token 成本，实用性强

items.title: Understand-Anything：将代码转为交互式知识图谱
items.desc: 将任意代码库转换为可探索、搜索和提问的交互式知识图谱，支持 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Copilot、Gemini CLI 等工具。
items.value: 代码理解和文档化新方式，降低项目上手难度

items.title: taste-skill：为 AI 注入“好品味”，避免生成千篇一律的内容
items.desc: 一个高自主性的前端工具，阻止 AI 生成无聊、通用、“垃圾”内容，提升 AI 输出的审美和独特性。
items.value: 解决 AI 内容同质化问题，提升输出质量

items.title: paseo：从手机、桌面和 CLI 远程编排编码代理
items.desc: 允许用户从手机、桌面或 CLI 远程编排和管理编码代理，实现跨设备 AI 编码工作流。
items.value: AI 编码工作流移动化，提升开发灵活性

items.title: rtk：CLI 代理，将常见开发命令的 token 消耗减少 60-90%
items.desc: 用 Rust 编写的 CLI 代理，针对常见开发命令可减少 60-90% 的 LLM token 消耗，单二进制文件，零依赖。
items.value: 开发场景下直接降低 AI 使用成本

items.title: ppt-master：AI 从任意文档生成原生可编辑 PPTX
items.desc: AI 从任意文档生成原生 PowerPoint 文件，使用真实形状而非图片，无需设计技能。
items.value: AI 办公自动化，直接生成可编辑的正式文档

en.headline: Microsoft Build 2026 Unveils 7 Major Updates, Including In-House Reasoning Model and AI Assistant
en.observation: The clearest signal today is the **paradigm shift from "building models" to "managing agents" in AI infrastructure**. Microsoft Build 2026's Scout, Meta's WhatsApp AI agent, and Coralogix's $200M funding all point in the same direction: AI agents are moving from demos to production, and managing, monitoring, and orchestrating these agents will be the next infrastructure-level opportunity. Simultaneously, token cost control has become an enterprise pain point—Uber's budget overrun and the popularity of compression tools like headroom and rtk show that "affordable AI" is more urgent than "how powerful AI is." Finally, Nvidia's RTX Spark brings AI inference to laptops, breaking edge AI hardware bottlenecks; developers should start paying attention to local deployment feasibility.

items.title: Anthropic Files for IPO, Aiming for Q4 Listing
items.desc: Anthropic has officially filed its IPO prospectus, planning to go public as early as Q4 2026, becoming one of the most anticipated AI IPOs.
items.value: AI unicorn capitalization milestone, influencing industry valuation and talent flow

items.title: Microsoft Build 2026 Unveils 7 Major Updates, Including In-House Reasoning Model and AI Assistant
items.desc: Microsoft announced flagship reasoning model MAI-Thinking-1, AI assistant Microsoft Scout (based on OpenClaw), and a suite of AI agent tools at Build, signaling a shift away from OpenAI dependency toward in-house development.
items.value: Microsoft-OpenAI ties loosen, in-house model ecosystem takes shape; developers should watch new platform

items.title: Google Launches Gemini Omni: Clone Your AI Avatar in 15 Minutes
items.desc: Google released Gemini Omni, allowing users to create their own AI digital avatar—including face cloning and voice synthesis—by scanning a QR code in under 15 minutes.
items.value: AI personal avatars enter practical use, significant impact on content creation and customer service

items.title: Google Launches Dreambeans: Turns Your Life Data into AI Comic Stories
items.desc: Google introduced Dreambeans, a tool that extracts data from users' Google accounts to generate personalized AI-illustrated "stories."
items.value: New paradigm for personal-data-driven AI storytelling, rekindling privacy vs. creativity debate

items.title: Meta's WhatsApp Business AI Agent Goes Global, Charged by Token Usage
items.desc: Meta announced the global availability of its WhatsApp Business AI agent, with businesses charged based on token usage, marking a new phase in AI customer service commercialization.
items.value: Large-scale commercialization of AI customer service, lowering entry barriers for SMBs

items.title: UK Regulator Mandates Google Allow Publishers to Opt Out of AI Search
items.desc: The UK's Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) ruled that Google must provide tools for website publishers to opt out of AI Search features (e.g., AI Overviews), with the option to be tested in the UK before global rollout.
items.value: AI search copyright battle escalates, reshaping content ecosystem rules

items.title: Alphabet's Record $85B Raise Fuels AI Business
items.desc: Alphabet completed its largest-ever $85 billion stock sale, dedicated to supporting Google's AI business, signaling strong investor confidence in the AI sector.
items.value: AI arms race gets ample funding ammunition, intensifying industry competition

items.title: Lovable Signs Multi-Year Renewal with Google Cloud, 5x Usage Increase
items.desc: AI app-building platform Lovable signed a multi-year expansion deal with Google Cloud, growing its footprint 5x and gaining expanded access to Anthropic Claude.
items.value: AI application platform infrastructure demand surges, cloud vendors benefit clearly

items.title: Coralogix Raises $200M, Betting on AI Agent Monitoring
items.desc: Infrastructure company Coralogix completed a $200M funding round, focusing on providing behavior monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational data platforms for AI agents.
items.value: AI agents enter production; ops monitoring becomes a new essential need

items.title: Nvidia RTX Spark Laptop Chips Debut, AI PC May Hit Tipping Point
items.desc: Nvidia released RTX Spark chips, poised to turn "AI PC" from concept into reality, delivering powerful local AI inference on laptops.
items.value: Edge AI inference hardware breakthrough; developers can deploy more complex local models

items.title: OpenAI Poaches Harvard's Youngest Tenured Professor, USTC Prodigy Alum
items.desc: OpenAI continues to strengthen its research team, hiring Harvard's youngest-ever tenured professor (who entered university at age 12) and renowned scholar Su Weijie.
items.value: Top AI talent war heats up, accelerating academic-to-industry flow

items.title: Uber Caps Employee AI Spending After Budget Exhausted in 4 Months
items.desc: After encouraging staff to use AI as much as possible, Uber was forced to cap AI usage due to budget overruns within four months.
items.value: Enterprise AI cost control becomes a new challenge; token economy needs finer management

items.title: Cross-dimensional Intelligence Tops WorldArena World Model Leaderboard
items.desc: Cross-dimensional Intelligence (Kuawei Zhineng) claimed the top spot on the WorldArena world model leaderboard, demonstrating progress in embodied AI and world understanding.
items.value: World model competition landscape shifts; new players challenge incumbents

items.title: WALL-WM: Event-Grounded World Action Model Pretraining
items.desc: Proposes WALL-WM, shifting video-action learning from fixed-length chunk optimization to semantically coherent action events as the atomic unit for Vision-Language-Action pretraining, addressing granularity mismatch in existing world action models.
items.value: Provides a more natural pretraining paradigm for embodied AI and robot learning

items.title: OmniOPD: Logit-Free On-Policy Distillation via Speculative Verification
items.desc: Introduces OmniOPD, enabling on-policy distillation without accessing teacher model logits via a speculative verification mechanism, allowing closed-source models to serve as teachers.
items.value: Reduces reliance on closed-model logits (e.g., GPT-4), making knowledge distillation more flexible

items.title: KVarN: Variance-Normalized KV-Cache Quantization
items.desc: Proposes KVarN, normalizing variance in KV-cache quantization to mitigate error accumulation during long-sequence decoding in reasoning tasks.
items.value: Improves long-context reasoning efficiency, alleviates memory bottlenecks

items.title: AURA: Action-Gated Memory for Robot Policies at Constant VRAM
items.desc: Introduces AURA-Mem, an action-gated memory architecture designed for edge robots, supporting long-horizon operation at constant VRAM, addressing KV-cache's unsuitability for robotics.
items.value: Breaks memory bottleneck for on-device robot inference, advancing embodied AI deployment

items.title: Small RL Controller, Large Language Model: RL-Guided Adaptive Sampling
items.desc: Formulates adaptive sampling for test-time scaling as an MDP, training a lightweight RL controller to dynamically decide when to stop sampling, improving reasoning while reducing cost.
items.value: Smarter test-time compute allocation, lowering inference costs

items.title: Ultralytics YOLO26: Unified Real-Time End-to-End Vision Models
items.desc: Releases YOLO26 series, achieving NMS-free end-to-end detection, lighter heads, shorter training schedules, and solving small-object positive assignment.
items.value: Major update to the most widely used CV model family

items.title: ByG: Unpaired Flow Matching for Image Editing
items.desc: Proposes Bootstrap Your Generator (ByG), leveraging base generative model priors to train flow matching editing models without paired data, extensible to video.
items.value: Drastically lowers training data requirements for image/video editing models

items.title: PaddleOCR-VL-1.6: Region-Aware Optimized Document Parsing Model
items.desc: Baidu releases PaddleOCR-VL-1.6, identifying "under-optimized regions" (unstable model behavior, sparse data coverage) and applying targeted data augmentation and progressive post-training, significantly boosting document parsing at 0.9B parameters.
items.value: Small model document parsing breakthrough, direct practical value for OCR and document processing

items.title: codegraph: Pre-Indexed Code Knowledge Graph to Cut AI Coding Agent Token Usage
items.desc: Provides a pre-indexed code knowledge graph for AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini, reducing token consumption and tool calls, running 100% locally.
items.value: Boosts AI coding efficiency, significantly lowers usage costs

items.title: oh-my-pi: Terminal AI Coding Agent
items.desc: A terminal AI coding agent supporting hash-anchored edits, optimized tool harness, LSP, Python, browser, subagents, and more.
items.value: New terminal AI agent option, feature-rich and extensible

items.title: headroom: Compress Tool Outputs and Logs, Cutting 60-95% Token Usage
items.desc: Compresses tool outputs, logs, files, and RAG chunks before they reach the LLM, reducing token consumption by 60-95% while maintaining answer quality. Available as library, proxy, and MCP server.
items.value: Directly reduces AI app token costs, highly practical

items.title: Understand-Anything: Turn Code into Interactive Knowledge Graphs
items.desc: Converts any codebase into an explorable, searchable, and queryable interactive knowledge graph, supporting Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI, and more.
items.value: New way to understand and document code, lowers project onboarding friction

items.title: taste-skill: Gives AI "Good Taste," Avoiding Generic Output
items.desc: A high-agency frontend tool that prevents AI from generating boring, generic, "slop" content, improving output aesthetics and uniqueness.
items.value: Addresses AI content homogenization, improves output quality

items.title: paseo: Orchestrate Coding Agents Remotely from Phone, Desktop, and CLI
items.desc: Allows users to remotely orchestrate and manage coding agents from phone, desktop, or CLI, enabling cross-device AI coding workflows.
items.value: Mobilizes AI coding workflows, boosts development flexibility

items.title: rtk: CLI Proxy Reducing Token Consumption by 60-90% on Common Dev Commands
items.desc: A Rust-based CLI proxy that reduces LLM token consumption by 60-90% on common development commands. Single binary, zero dependencies.
items.value: Directly lowers AI usage costs in development scenarios

items.title: ppt-master: AI Generates Natively Editable PPTX from Any Document
items.desc: AI generates native PowerPoint files from any document using real shapes (not images), requiring no design skills.
items.value: AI office automation, directly generates editable formal documents
